title: Microsoft Entra Permissions Management - Simply Explained

entities.name: Microsoft Azure
entities.quote: you set up a cloud service, maybe Azure, maybe AWS

entities.name: Microsoft Entra
entities.quote: Microsoft Entra permissions management. What exactly is it?

quotes.text: Most people think managing permissions is about assigning roles. You give someone, contributor or owner, and you're done. But that's not the real problem. The real problem is losing track of who has too much power.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Reframes permission management around visibility rather than assignment.

quotes.text: Then it watches what those identities actually do, not what they can do. That gap between granted permissions and used permissions is where the risk lives.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains the core idea behind usage-based permission analysis.

quotes.text: Instead of granting access just in case someone might need it, you grant access just in time for when they actually do.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Contrasts just-in-case with just-in-time access in one sentence.

quotes.text: PIM manages the front door security. It decides who gets to walk through and when. Permissions management checks every room in the building.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clarifies the difference between PIM and Permissions Management with a clear analogy.

quotes.text: This metric is gold for auditors and security teams. It's objective. It's measurable. It's trackable.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Highlights why the Permission Creep Index is useful for proving progress.

chapters.title: Why the old way is broken

takeaways: Permission creep happens when identities keep permissions long after projects end, and Entra Permissions Management reveals the gap between granted and actually used permissions across Azure, AWS and GCP.
The Permission Creep Index gives each identity a measurable risk score, and permissions on demand replaces just-in-case rights with time-limited, scoped access.
PIM controls when privileged roles are active while Permissions Management controls what permissions exist; start with a pilot subscription, the free trial and simulation mode.
hook: Over time, users, service principals and scripts pile up cloud permissions nobody remembers granting, and attackers love that. This episode explains Microsoft Entra Permissions Management in plain English for cloud and security admins running Azure, AWS or GCP. You will learn how it discovers, right-sizes and monitors permissions and how it differs from PIM.
